en: The things we consume work like signs, some saying welcome and others saying keep out. It is through them that people align with some, set themselves apart from others and give meaning to what they live. The skin does this inside the game, because it shows which group you belong to and who does not belong to it.
What is required is that the punishment have a verifiable reason, consistency from one decision to the next and an understandable path to challenge it.
